# Bundled browser dependencies

The frontend serves these distributions locally and preserves their upstream copyright headers. They are third-party libraries, separate from the project's own code.

| Distribution | Bundled version | Upstream | License text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `marked.min.js` | 15.0.12 | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/tree/v15.0.12) | [MIT](marked-LICENSE.md) |
| `purify.min.js` | 3.2.7 | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/tree/3.2.7) | [Apache 2.0 / MPL 2.0](DOMPurify-LICENSE.txt) |

Versions and license designations are recorded in the bundled distributions' headers. License files are copied from their corresponding upstream tags. Any update should replace the distribution and its matching license information together.
